GPU power, connectors, PSU capacity, and clearance.

A practical fit check before installing a graphics card.

01

Power is more than a wattage label

Compare the exact board power and manufacturer PSU recommendation. Account for CPU and other components, connector type, cable guidance, and transient behavior.

02

Physical fit has several dimensions

Verify card length, height, thickness or slot count, power-plug clearance, radiator position, and airflow. Partner cards using the same GPU can differ substantially.

03

Installation checklist

Use dedicated cables as the PSU maker directs, seat connectors fully, support heavy cards, and confirm that no cable is sharply bent at the plug. Follow the exact product manuals.

Sources and verification

Use the exact product manuals and support lists linked from each catalog record. Industry specifications are maintained by organizations such as PCI-SIG, JEDEC, and NVM Express. Product implementations can be narrower than an industry standard.

Apply the checklist to real parts.
